Money.description: An amount in a currency. Claude reports USD.

PauseCause.description:
Why a run or a phase is paused (0.2, 0.3, 0.8). `ask_human` waits in the Queue, `usage_limit` waits for the
account's reset time, and `disk` is the free-space floor: nothing is started until space comes back (0.2).

RecordedCall.description:
One model call of a run's record, as `collide run` prints it. Each figure is absent when the agent did not report
it: 0.13's missing is not zero, so an absent `cost` is "not reported" and never `$0`. `scope` says what the line is: a
`turn`, a `compaction`, `other_calls`, or a `step` for a turn that was cut before its `result` (the tokens of the
responses it did get, which are `partial`: their output and cost are not known). `wall_ms` is Collide's own
measure of the turn it sent, and is absent for a line that is not a turn it sent. `model_ms` is the agent's
`duration_api_ms` as a difference of its running total.

RunState.description:
Where a run is (0.8, Run). It ends `ended(<outcome>)`, `failed` or `stopped`; `outcome` is the `end` token the run
reached (0.7, Outcomes and terminal states). `integrating` is a run whose `integrate` answered `pending`, so the
pull request is not merged yet (0.4).

UsageQuality.description:
How far the figures of a [`Usage`] event can be trusted. A total built from `partial` figures is shown as "at
least" and never summed with `exact` ones (0.13).

UsageScope.description:
What a [`Usage`] event counts: one turn, one model step, the session so far, a compaction call, or another model call
outside the turn's own (0.3, Usage).

oneOf.description:
The model call of a compaction. A turn's own usage leaves it out, so it is its own event, never added into a
`Turn` (0.3, Usage; S9).

A model call that is neither the turn's own nor a compaction: a helper-model call, read as what the agent
reports for the turn beyond the turn's own usage. Never added into a `Turn` either.

description:
`run.record` result: what `collide run` prints at the end, and what it shows when it reattaches. `state` is the
run's state as the daemon last recorded it. `failure` is why a phase failed when its session could say (`no_result`,
`budget`, `disk`, `api_500`, ...). `report` is the final report. `calls` are the model calls in the order they were
recorded. `wall_ms` is the run's length (absent while it has none to give), and `workspace` the worktree.
title: RunRecordResult
